readout_other: in vivo fEPSP recording in dentate gyrus: LTP (theta burst), depotentiation (low frequency stimulation), paired-pulse ratio
direction_notes: 0.15 MPa TUS inhibited LTP and DEP whereas 0.3 MPa TUS promoted them; TMAS promoted LTP, DEP and PPR more than TUS, with the coupled electric field amplitude having the larger effect. Static magnetic field alone had no significant effect.

exposures.label: Hippocampus, TUS 0.15/0.3 MPa and TMAS (static field 0.1/0.2 T, coupled field 0.2/0.4 V/m); separate magnet-only groups

target.label: hippocampal region (center: Anterior-Posterior (AP) 3 mm, Medial-Lateral (ML) 2.4 mm)

timing.protocol_description: Ultrasonic pulse with a main frequency of 1 MHz, repetition frequency of 1 kHz and duty cycle of 10%, each stimulation lasting 5 minutes, once a day for 7 days.

source_quotes.n_subjects: Forty-eight male mice (24 2.50 g, 6–8 weeks old) were randomized into 6 mice in each group for a total of 8 groups.
source_quotes.n_sessions_per_subject: Mice were stimulated once a day for 5 min and continuously stimulated for 7 days.
